tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: The page ground behind everything, marketing and app alike. Grounds for ink, ink-muted, accent, ok, warn and danger.

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Cards, calendar day columns, table bodies, the details panel. Grounds for ink, ink-muted and every cat-N.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells that hold cards: the unscheduled tray, table headers, the calendar gutter. Grounds for ink and ink-muted.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Anything floating over the page: popovers, menus, toasts, and an item while it is being dragged. Pair with shadow-panel or shadow-lift. Grounds for ink and ink-muted.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: The hover and keyboard-focus wash on rows, list items and ghost buttons. Never the only signal that a row is selected.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All primary text and icons, on surface-page, surface-card, surface-sunken, surface-raised and every cat-N-soft. Also the fill of the one inverted section a page may use, carrying ink-inverse.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: timestamps, channel names, table captions, taglines. On surface-page, surface-card and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Marks only, never body text: disabled glyphs, the hour labels in the calendar gutter, placeholder rules. Holds 3:1 on surface-page and surface-card.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a field filled with ink — the one inverted section a page may use, and nothing else.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Every hairline rule at size-hairline: card edges, table rows, calendar grid, section dividers. Structural only, never the sole carrier of meaning.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that carry meaning: input and select outlines, secondary button edges, toggle tracks. Measures 3.26:1 on surface-page and 3.75:1 on surface-card in Daylight, 3.69:1 on surface-card in Lamplight.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Bureau's one brand colour, the editor's pencil. Link text, active nav, the primary fill, the selected-day rule. As text on surface-page, surface-card and accent-soft.

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: The pressed and hovered state of an accent fill, and the colour of focus-ring. As text on surface-page and surface-card.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent or accent-strong fill. Dark in Lamplight because the accent lightens there — never hard-code white.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fields in the brand colour: the selected calendar day, an accent badge, the active nav pill. Carries ink and accent.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: The 2px solid focus ring on every interactive element, offset 2px. An alias of accent-strong, so a change to one moves both. Clears 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Published, connected, saved. Teal rather than green so it never relies on a red–green distinction. Always beside the word. On surface-page, surface-card and ok-soft.

tokens.name: ok-soft
tokens.usage: The fill behind an ok badge or a connected integration row. Carries ink and ok.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: A timing check: a social post due before its article, or an article with no time yet. Always beside the words. On surface-page, surface-card and warn-soft.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: The fill behind a timing-check badge and the flagged calendar chip's rail band. Carries ink and warn.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Failed sends, destructive confirmations, field errors. Always beside the words. On surface-page, surface-card and danger-soft.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: The fill behind a failed badge and an error summary. Carries ink and danger.

tokens.name: cat-0
tokens.usage: Platform slot 0, Other. The rail, dot and label of a chip for an unrecognised channel. On surface-card and cat-0-soft.

tokens.name: cat-1
tokens.usage: Platform slot 1, Ghost. Chip rail, dot and label; the article node in a story. On surface-card and cat-1-soft.

tokens.name: cat-2
tokens.usage: Platform slot 2, LinkedIn. Chip rail, dot and label. On surface-card and cat-2-soft.

tokens.name: cat-3
tokens.usage: Platform slot 3, Bluesky. Chip rail, dot and label. On surface-card and cat-3-soft.

tokens.name: cat-4
tokens.usage: Platform slot 4, X. Chip rail, dot and label. On surface-card and cat-4-soft.

tokens.name: cat-5
tokens.usage: Platform slot 5, Threads. Chip rail, dot and label. On surface-card and cat-5-soft.

tokens.name: cat-6
tokens.usage: Platform slot 6, Facebook. Chip dot, mark and label. Violet rather than amber so no platform shares a hex with warn. On surface-card and cat-6-soft.

tokens.name: cat-7
tokens.usage: Platform slot 7, Mastodon. Chip rail, dot and label. On surface-card and cat-7-soft.

tokens.name: cat-8
tokens.usage: Platform slot 8, Instagram. Chip rail, dot and label. On surface-card and cat-8-soft.

tokens.name: cat-0-soft
tokens.usage: Chip and legend fill for platform slot 0. Carries ink and cat-0.

tokens.name: cat-1-soft
tokens.usage: Chip and legend fill for platform slot 1. Carries ink and cat-1.

tokens.name: cat-2-soft
tokens.usage: Chip and legend fill for platform slot 2. Carries ink and cat-2.

tokens.name: cat-3-soft
tokens.usage: Chip and legend fill for platform slot 3. Carries ink and cat-3.

tokens.name: cat-4-soft
tokens.usage: Chip and legend fill for platform slot 4. Carries ink and cat-4.

tokens.name: cat-5-soft
tokens.usage: Chip and legend fill for platform slot 5. Carries ink and cat-5.

tokens.name: cat-6-soft
tokens.usage: Chip and legend fill for platform slot 6. Carries ink and cat-6.

tokens.name: cat-7-soft
tokens.usage: Chip and legend fill for platform slot 7. Carries ink and cat-7.

tokens.name: cat-8-soft
tokens.usage: Chip and legend fill for platform slot 8. Carries ink and cat-8.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind a modal confirmation. Nothing else dims the page.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: The largest type in the system, once per page. A marketing hero, and nothing in the app.

styles.name: display-m
styles.usage: Section openers on the site. The app never reaches this size.

styles.name: display-s
styles.usage: The one display size the app uses: an empty state’s headline.

styles.name: heading-l
styles.usage: The app view title, one per screen.

styles.name: heading-m
styles.usage: Card and panel titles, story titles, an install option’s name.

styles.name: heading-s
styles.usage: Sub-headings inside a card, and table column headers. Set below body so a header never reads as a first data row.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Capitals applied by the component, never typed. Tray headers, calendar day names, metric labels. Never above a heading.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: Bureau puts every queued item on one calendar and says when they disagree.
styles.usage: The sentence under a display headline. One paragraph, stopping at size-measure.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Drag an item to another hour to move it.
styles.usage: Default running text on every surface, marketing and app alike.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Dense app text: chip titles, panel hints, toast copy, table cells.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Field hints, metric footnotes, figure captions, provenance. Set in ink-muted.

styles.name: numeral-xl
styles.usage: The figure on an analytics metric tile.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Every number in a table cell, so a column aligns on the digit.

styles.name: time
styles.usage: Clock times and dates wherever they appear: chips, the calendar gutter, the date-time field, story rows.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Environment variables, commands, file paths, and an install option’s requirement line.

spacing.note: A 4px grid, with one 2px exception named space-half. The calendar’s hour row is space-7; the app gutter is size-app-gutter.

tokens.name: space-half
tokens.usage: The one sub-grid step, 2px: the gap between a chip’s dot and its mark, and nothing larger.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a badge's dot and its word; the grid everything else is cut from.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Padding inside a chip, gap between stacked chips, gap between a label and its field.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Padding inside inputs and buttons; gap between cards in a tray.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Standard card padding and the gap between form rows.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Panel padding, gap between cards in a grid, the app's page gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections inside a view; padding of a marketing card.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: One hour of calendar height, and the gap between a heading and its content block.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: The marketing site's gutter, and the gap between stacked feature rows.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of a marketing section. The largest step; do not invent a bigger one.

radius.note: Small and deliberate. One radius for things you click, one for things that hold things, one for the toggle. Marketing uses the same three.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: The chip rail and the toggle knob's travel track end.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, calendar chips, table-row hover, keyboard key caps.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects. The default for anything you click.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, toasts, the unscheduled tray, the app window, and a marketing figure. The largest radius in the system.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: The toggle track and knob, and nothing else.

shadow.note: Bureau separates things with line, not shadow. Only something genuinely off the page gets one.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus, the details panel when it floats, and toasts on surface-raised.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: An item while it is being dragged across the calendar, and only then.

size.note: Fixed measurements the layout depends on. Lengths only; nothing composite.

tokens.name: size-hairline
tokens.usage: Every rule drawn in line or line-strong.

tokens.name: size-rail
tokens.usage: The platform-coloured rail down the left edge of a calendar chip and a story row.

tokens.name: size-control-sm
tokens.usage: Height of a small button, a chip-sized control and the toggle.

tokens.name: size-control-md
tokens.usage: Height of the default button, input, select and date-time field.

tokens.name: size-control-lg
tokens.usage: Height of a marketing call-to-action and the primary action in a panel footer.

tokens.name: size-icon
tokens.usage: Every icon beside text at body or body-sm.

tokens.name: size-icon-lg
tokens.usage: Icons in nav, empty states and metric tiles.

tokens.name: size-time-gutter
tokens.usage: The calendar’s hour-label column. 09:00 set in time measures about 33px; 40px holds it with space-1 of padding at every supported zoom.

tokens.name: size-app-gutter
tokens.usage: Side padding of the app shell and of a view’s content column.

tokens.name: size-measure
tokens.usage: Maximum line length for any paragraph set in lede or body.
